description:
## Objective

Create the shared quality structure and command interface.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U1`
Covers: `R1, R2, R3; KTD1, KTD2, KTD3, KTD5.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: None.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.2 (U2) — Activate authoring and Covenant gates must be complete; jido-07x.3 (U3) — Port Signal property and fuzz checks must be complete; jido-07x.4 (U4) — Port Signal benchmark smoke checks must be complete.

## Files

Change `mix.exs`, `.formatter.exs`, and `test/test_helper.exs`. Add `test/quality/source_manifest.yml`, `test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs`, and `test/quality/README.md`. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Add all focused aliases with empty-safe target paths and fixed seed `0`.
2. Extend formatter inputs to `examples/**` and `bench/**`.
3. Add the manifest schema and records for every source suite root.
4. Add validation for full commit SHAs, allowed states, unique target paths, and existing files for `ported` records.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Manifest validation rejects missing commits, unknown states, duplicate target paths, and missing ported files.
- [ ] Default `mix test` excludes every special tag.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs` and `mix format --check-formatted` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed efd9315. Changed .formatter.exs, mix.exs, test/test_helper.exs, docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md, and test/quality/{README.md,source_manifest.yml,source_manifest_test.exs}. Manifest records: 35 source-suite roots across jido_signal, jido_action, jido_v3_split, and jido_ai; one existing authoring corpus is ported, core LLM assets are superseded, research/proposed and broad legacy core benchmark assets are excluded, and remaining planned imports are deferred to their registered tickets. Verification passed: mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs (6 passed); mix format --check-formatted; empty-safe mix test.property. Deferred assets require later tickets only; no product-gap failure occurred. Deviation: none. Remaining blockers: none for this ticket. No lib or refs files changed.
